==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am watching television. There is a special on about black heroes. The special seems to be focused on real people.

Suddenly the special shows footage of Aladdin running through the White House. He is darting between pillars as cameras follow his every move. I am puzzled.

I am wondering why Aladdin would be included in this special. I start to question if Aladdin is real, why Aladdin was running through the White House, and if I'd consider him to be black. More importantly, I wonder if his genie is real, and what powers it might possess.
